airspace.zh: 約旦規定：所有無人機都要向民航管理委員會（CARC）登記，飛行須經內政部核准，至少提前十個工作天向CARC申請；高度不得超過400英尺，只能在核准地點周圍500公尺內、核准的時間飛行；操作者須年滿21歲並投保責任險。2025年起實施的修訂，簡化了部分執照程序。實際飛行前請先向CARC確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Jordan: all drones must be registered with the Civil Aviation Regulatory Commission (CARC), and flights need Ministry of Interior approval, applied for through CARC at least 10 working days ahead; stay below 400 ft and within 500 m of the approved location at the approved times; operators must be at least 21 and insured. Amendments in force from 2025 simplify some licensing. Check the current rules with CARC before any real flight.

title.en: Twelve Thousand Years in the Desert

tagline.zh-Hant: 兩萬五千幅岩畫、納巴泰神殿、勞倫斯與阿拉伯起義，到2011年的世界遺產
tagline.en: 25,000 rock carvings, a Nabataean temple, Lawrence and the Arab Revolt, and World Heritage in 2011

zh: 這裡是約旦南部的瓦地倫，
靠近沙烏地阿拉伯邊界，在阿卡巴東邊大約六十公里。
en: This is Wadi Rum in southern Jordan,
near the Saudi border, about 60 km east of Aqaba.

zh: 它也叫「月亮谷」；
「瓦地倫」在阿拉伯文裡，是「細沙之谷」的意思。
en: It is also called the Valley of the Moon;
the Arabic name means "valley of light, airborne sand".

zh: 人類在這裡生活，至少已經一萬兩千年；
留下了兩萬五千幅岩畫，和兩萬條銘文。
en: People have lived here for at least 12,000 years,
leaving 25,000 rock carvings and 20,000 inscriptions.

zh: 一百五十四處考古遺址，從新石器時代到納巴泰時期；
銘文用了四種文字，包括薩姆德文、納巴泰文和阿拉伯文。
en: Its 154 archaeological sites run from the Neolithic to the Nabataean period;
the inscriptions use four scripts, including Thamudic, Nabataean and Arabic.

zh: 這些岩畫與銘文，
記錄了早期字母的發展。
en: These carvings and inscriptions
record the early development of the alphabet.

zh: 青銅時代之後，氣候變得更乾，
人們用集水設施，在沙漠裡繼續生活。
en: After the Bronze Age the climate grew drier,
and people used water catchment systems to live on in the desert.

zh: 納巴泰神殿在1933年被發現，
1997年，一支法國團隊完成了發掘。
en: The Nabataean temple was discovered in 1933,
and a French team completed its excavation in 1997.

zh: 艾因沙拉萊泉邊，有納巴泰人的銘文；
T・E・勞倫斯，曾經描寫過這道泉水。
en: The Ain Shalaaleh spring carries Nabataean inscriptions;
T. E. Lawrence described it.

zh: 1917到1918年的阿拉伯起義期間，
勞倫斯好幾次經過瓦地倫。
en: During the Arab Revolt of 1917–18
Lawrence passed through Wadi Rum several times.

zh: 一座原名「馬茲馬爾山」的岩峰，
在1980年代，以他的書改名為「智慧七柱」。
en: A rock formation once called Jabal al-Mazmar
was renamed the Seven Pillars of Wisdom in the 1980s, after Lawrence's book.

zh: 1949年，謝赫・哈姆丹帶著測量員登上倫山；
1952年11月，兩位女性完成了歐洲人的首次登頂。
en: In 1949 Sheikh Hamdan guided surveyors to the summit of Jabal Rum;
in November 1952 Charmian Longstaff and Sylvia Branford made the first recorded European ascent.

zh: 薩拉比亞貝都因人在1980年前後來到這裡，
今天村子裡有學校，也有沙漠巡邏隊的總部。
en: The Zalabieh Bedouin arrived around 1980;
today the village has schools and the Desert Patrol headquarters.

zh: 南邊的烏姆達米山，是約旦的最高點；
最早找到它的，是薩拉比亞人迪法拉・阿提格。
en: Jabal Umm ad Dami to the south is Jordan's highest point;
it was first located by Difallah Ateeg of the Zalabia.

zh: 1997年，這裡成為保護區，2002年擴大；
2011年，列入世界遺產，是自然與文化的雙重遺產。
en: The protected area was set up in 1997 and extended in 2002;
in 2011 it became a mixed natural and cultural World Heritage site.

zh: 從新石器時代的獵人，到今天的貝都因人，
一萬兩千年來，人們都在這片沙漠裡留下了名字。
en: From Neolithic hunters to the Bedouin of today,
people have left their names in this desert for twelve thousand years.

tagline.zh-Hant: 《阿拉伯的勞倫斯》帶起的觀光、火星電影外景、貝都因攀岩路線與沙漠營地
tagline.en: The tourism Lawrence of Arabia began, a stand-in for Mars, Bedouin climbing routes and more and more camps

zh: 1962年的電影《阿拉伯的勞倫斯》，在這裡拍攝沙漠場景，
帶起了約旦的觀光業。
en: The desert scenes of Lawrence of Arabia (1962), filmed here,
kick-started Jordan's tourism industry.

zh: 這裡常被用來拍以火星為背景的科幻電影，
包括《絕地救援》。
en: It is often used for science-fiction films set on Mars,
among them The Martian.

zh: 《星際大戰外傳：俠盜一號》也在瓦地倫拍攝；
約旦電影委員會因此在2017年得到國際外景協會的獎。
en: Rogue One was also filmed in Wadi Rum,
and in 2017 Jordan's Royal Film Commission won an LMGI award for it.

zh: 2017年，有十六萬兩千名遊客來到瓦地倫。
en: In 2017, 162,000 tourists visited Wadi Rum.

zh: 貝都因人世世代代攀爬這些砂岩，
他們的「貝都因之路」，後來被攀岩者一條條記錄下來。
en: The Bedouin have climbed this sandstone for generations,
and modern climbers have documented their "Bedouin Roads".

zh: 1984年，英國攀岩者在這裡開出第一批有紀錄的路線；
1987年，第一本攀岩指南出版。
en: The first recorded rock climbs were made in 1984 by English climbers;
the first climbing guidebook came out in 1987.

zh: 倫山上大約有十條攀爬路線，
最受歡迎的是「薩姆德路線」和「謝赫哈姆丹路線」。
en: About ten scrambling routes cross Jabal Rum;
the most popular are the Thamudic and Sheikh Hamdan's routes.

zh: 2000年的「聖戰」，是瓦地倫第一條全程打釘的路線，
長四百五十公尺。
en: Guerre Sainte, climbed in 2000, was the first fully bolted route in Wadi Rum,
450 metres long.

zh: 東南邊的布爾達石橋，估計高三十五公尺，
跨過一道深溝，人可以走過它的頂端。
en: To the southeast, the Rock Bridge of Burdah, about 35 metres high,
spans a deep gully, and you can walk across its top.

zh: 上去的路很難走，有陡坡和兩段暴露的煙囪地形；
路線沒有標示，建議請貝都因嚮導帶路。
en: The hike is hard, with steep sections and two exposed chimneys;
the routes are unmarked, so Bedouin guides are recommended.

zh: 烏姆弗魯斯石橋是一座獨立的石拱，
估計高十五公尺，可以從斜坡爬上頂端。
en: The Rock Bridge of Um Fruth stands on its own,
about 15 metres high, with its top reached by slabs.

zh: 2023年12月的調查，有二百二十九座營運中的沙漠營地；
2019年，估計有大約四百座沒有執照。
en: A December 2023 baseline counted 229 active desert camps;
in 2019 about 400 were estimated to be unlicensed.

zh: 2011年有五百到一千輛四輪傳動車在沙漠裡跑；
2019年的非正式估計，是一千到一千五百輛。
en: Some 500 to 1,000 four-wheel-drive vehicles were operating in 2011;
informal reports suggest 1,000 to 1,500 in 2019.

zh: 保護區有八十多名員工，很多是當地的貝都因人；
由阿卡巴經濟特區管理局經營。
en: The protected area has more than 80 staff, many of them local Bedouin;
it is run by the Aqaba Special Economic Zone Authority.

zh: 電影、攀岩與營地，
讓這片沙漠成了全世界的舞台。
en: Films, climbs and camps
have made this desert a stage for the world.

tagline.zh-Hant: 不到一百毫米的年雨量、重新引進的阿拉伯大羚羊、努比亞羱羊與峭壁上的刺柏
tagline.en: Under 100 mm of rain a year, reintroduced Arabian oryx, Nubian ibex and cliff-top junipers

zh: 瓦地倫一年的雨量，只有五十到一百毫米，
雨都在冬天落下。
en: Wadi Rum receives only 50 to 100 mm of rain a year,
falling in winter.

zh: 雨多半來自雷雨和山洪；
嚴重的乾旱，越來越常發生。
en: Most of it comes from thunderstorms and flash floods,
and serious droughts have become frequent.

zh: 這裡記錄到一百八十三種植物、二十六種哺乳動物，
三十四種爬蟲類，和一百一十九種鳥。
en: Some 183 plant species, 26 mammals,
34 reptiles and 119 bird species have been recorded here.

zh: 一百一十九種鳥裡，
三十四種在這裡繁殖，八十五種是過境的候鳥。
en: Of the 119 birds,
34 breed here and 85 are migrants.

zh: 倫山的山區住著努比亞羱羊，
是易危的物種。
en: Nubian ibex live in the Rum mountains,
a species listed as Vulnerable.

zh: 2005年，在阿布達比環境署協助下，
阿拉伯大羚羊重新被引進這裡。
en: In 2005 Arabian oryx were reintroduced here,
with help from the Abu Dhabi environment agency.

zh: 這裡也記錄到獰貓、灰狼和條紋鬣狗；
沙貓和阿拉伯豹，不久之前也還在這一帶出沒。
en: Caracal, grey wolf and striped hyena have been recorded;
sand cat and Arabian leopard were here not long ago.

zh: 這一帶看得到黑鵰，
還有中東特有的西奈朱雀和休氏林鴞。
en: Verreaux's eagles are seen in the area,
along with the Sinai rosefinch and Hume's tawny owl of the Middle East.

zh: 沙丘植被佔了這裡大約六成，
以白梭梭為主，大多在北部、東部和中部。
en: Sand-dune vegetation covers about 60% of the site,
dominated by white saxaul, mostly in the north, east and centre.

zh: 西邊和南邊是礫石荒漠，
岩屑坡上長著金合歡。
en: Stony desert lies to the west and south,
and acacias grow on the rocky slopes.

zh: 在峭壁的頂上，
還留著稀疏的腓尼基刺柏林。
en: On the cliff tops
a sparse woodland of relict Phoenician juniper survives.

zh: 2000年以後，駱駝越來越多，
放牧的壓力，在局部地區變得嚴重。
en: Camel numbers have risen since 2000,
and grazing is becoming locally serious.

zh: 世界自然保護聯盟2025年的評估：
前景「良好，但有些問題要注意」。
en: IUCN's 2025 assessment
rated the outlook as "good, with some concerns".

zh: 緩衝區正在擴大兩倍以上，
到一千三百四十一平方公里。
en: The buffer zone is being enlarged by more than 200%,
to 1,341 square kilometres.

zh: 在一年不到一百毫米的雨裡，
羱羊、羚羊和刺柏，仍然找到了活下去的方法。
en: With less than 100 mm of rain a year,
ibex, oryx and junipers still find a way to live.

title.en: Half a Billion Years of Sandstone

tagline.zh-Hant: 五億年前的砂岩、阿拉伯地盾、蜂窩狀風化、天然石橋與約旦的最高點
tagline.en: Sandstone 500 million years old, the Arabian Shield, honeycomb weathering, rock bridges and Jordan’s summit

zh: 瓦地倫面積大約七百二十平方公里，
是約旦最大的乾谷。
en: Wadi Rum covers about 720 square kilometres,
the largest wadi in Jordan.

zh: 山壁是倫群的石英砂岩，
在五億四千萬到四億七千萬年前沉積下來。
en: The cliffs are Rum Group quartz sandstones,
laid down 540 to 470 million years ago.

zh: 底下是阿拉伯地盾前寒武紀的基盤，
由深成岩和變質岩組成。
en: Beneath lies the Precambrian basement of the Arabian Shield,
made of plutonic and metamorphic rock.

zh: 寒武紀的薩拉布砂岩，是四十到六十公尺高的基座；
上面的烏姆伊什林砂岩，形成了垂直的峭壁。
en: The Lower Cambrian Salab sandstone forms a 40 to 60 metre plinth;
the Umm Ishrin sandstone above it forms the sheer cliffs.

zh: 烏姆伊什林砂岩富含鐵質、很耐侵蝕，
奧陶紀的迪西砂岩，蓋在山頂。
en: The Umm Ishrin sandstone is iron-rich and resists erosion,
and the Ordovician Disi sandstone caps the buttes.

zh: 地下水積在砂岩和花崗岩的交界，
在山的東坡湧出成泉。
en: Groundwater gathers where the sandstone meets the granite
and emerges as springs on the eastern slopes.

zh: 這一帶到今天還在抬升，
大約每一千年七十毫米。
en: The area is still rising,
at about 70 mm every thousand years.

zh: 風雕出了蜂窩狀的風化孔、天然石橋，
還有新月形沙丘和爬升沙丘。
en: The wind has carved honeycomb weathering and natural bridges,
along with barchan and climbing dunes.

zh: 周圍的山，大多高出地面約四百公尺，
底部是花崗岩或紫色砂岩，山頂是白色砂岩。
en: Most of the surrounding mountains rise about 400 metres,
on bases of granite or purple sandstone with white sandstone summits.

zh: 倫山海拔一千七百三十四公尺，
是約旦第二高的山。
en: Jabal Rum rises to 1,734 metres,
Jordan's second-highest peak.

zh: 倫村南邊大約三十公里的烏姆達米山，
海拔一千八百五十四公尺，是約旦的最高點。
en: Jabal Umm ad Dami, about 30 km south of Rum village,
reaches 1,854 metres, Jordan's highest point.

zh: 它就在沙烏地阿拉伯邊界附近，
位在世界遺產的緩衝區裡。
en: It stands near the border with Saudi Arabia,
within the World Heritage buffer zone.

zh: 七月平均最高溫三十四點六度，
一月平均最低溫四點六度。
en: In July the mean daily maximum is 34.6 °C;
in January the mean minimum is 4.6 °C.

zh: 五億年的砂岩，加上風與水，
雕出了這座月亮般的山谷。
en: Half a billion years of sandstone, worked by wind and water,
have carved this valley of the moon.
